Input image: identity and artwork reference for caloy, preserve this exact character's face/head, skin, hair, clothing, distinguishing accessories or face markings, red gloves, dark outlines, flat cartoon shading and simple exaggerated limbs. Do not replace the face or costume with a generic boxer.
Create ONE square 1024 x 1024 PNG sheet with a genuine transparent background. Strict invisible 2-column by 2-row grid, equal 512 x 512 cells, read row-major. No grid lines, numbers, labels, captions, shadows, backgrounds or watermarks. One full-body character in each used cell, never crossing cell edges. All frames face RIGHT in a three-quarter side-view boxing pose. In each cell the feet baseline is y=480, neutral body visible height about 384, body center/pivot x=256. Maintain exactly equal body size, head proportions and foot baseline between frames; allow arms to extend within the cell. Leave generous transparent margins. SIDEWAYS BOXING FOOTWORK facing RIGHT throughout: cell 1 left step contact, cell 2 passing feet, cell 3 opposite step contact, cell 4 passing feet. Clear lateral leg/foot movement, both gloves guarding. Do not turn to face the camera or left.  Use all four cells.
Anatomically coherent two arms, two gloved hands, two legs, two feet. The leg pose and gloved arm pose must change visibly according to the action. Keep the original simple stylized character rather than realistic anatomy. Do not add graphics/effects.
